html:
Tastil is an archaeological site of a large pre-Hispanic town in the Quebrada del Toro in Salta, northwestern Argentina, near the village of Santa Rosa de Tastil.

The town was built on a ridge with stone houses, narrow streets and plazas, and is often called the largest pre-Hispanic town in Argentina. It flourished in the 1300s and was abandoned in the 1400s, around the time the Incas reached the region. Its people farmed terraces, herded llamas and traded between the high puna and the valleys. Peoples nearby included the Omaguaca, the Ocloya and the Diaguita.
sum: Tastil is an archaeological site of a large pre-Hispanic town in the Quebrada del Toro in Salta, northwestern Argentina, near the village of Santa Rosa de Tastil.
